metadata.task: Navigate to the patient room, retrieve the patient file, and return it to the reception desk.

plan.goal: Navigate to the patient room, retrieve the patient file, and return it to the reception desk.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the General Ward (patient room zone).

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 maps to Nav2 NavigateToPose action, utilizing the robot's can_navigate and supports_indoor_navigation capabilities.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Detect and locate the patient file on a table within the General Ward.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at General Ward with patient file pose estimated.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_001 maps to ROS2 Perception topic /detections, utilizing the robot's can_detect_objects and has_visual_perception capabilities.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Estimate the precise 3D pose of the patient file.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at General Ward with patient file detected.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at General Ward with patient file pose estimated.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_009 maps to ROS2 Perception topic /object_poses, utilizing the robot's can_detect_objects and can_estimate_range capabilities.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the estimated pose of the patient file.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at General Ward with patient file pose estimated.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_014 maps to Nav2 NavigateToPose action, utilizing the robot's can_navigate and can_detect_objects capabilities.
Skill MAN_001 maps to MoveIt2 MoveGroup action, utilizing the robot's can_pick, can_grasp, and can_manipulate capabilities.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot holding patient file at General Ward.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot holding patient file at Reception Desk.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 maps to Nav2 NavigateToPose action, utilizing the robot's can_navigate and supports_indoor_navigation capabilities.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the patient file on the Reception Desk.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot holding patient file at Reception Desk.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at Reception Desk, patient file placed.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 maps to MoveIt2 MoveGroup action, utilizing the robot's can_place and can_manipulate capabilities.

constraints: Robot cannot climb stairs; assumes elevators or ramps exist between zones.
Robot has limited payload; assumes patient file fits within payload capacity.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Robot successfully navigates to the General Ward, detects and picks up the patient file, navigates to the Reception Desk, and places the file there.
